metadata.title: Short-Term AI Fear, Long-Term Compute Scarcity
metadata.speaker: Jordi Visser

executive_takeaway: Jordi Visser argues we're in a short-term AI sentiment pullback ('mini bear market') within a powerful secular bull market driven by structural compute scarcity. Key thesis: model abundance + Jevons Paradox = exponentially growing compute demand that physical infrastructure cannot match at software speed. Google's $514B cloud backlog (up from $106B YoY) and 82% cloud growth prove demand outpaces capacity. China's state-backed AI race (DeepSeek, Moonshot/Kimi) makes this a two-horse geopolitical contest. Near-term: optical/photonics step-up function (Marvell largest position, added AOI), profit margins at all-time highs, estimate revisions as key signal. Long-term: bearish on all public AI cos by 2030 unless AGI arrives slower or governments prop markets. Crypto/blockchain emerging as parallel infrastructure layer as important as AI.

ai_workflows.name: Mosaic Method / Mixture of Experts Prompt
ai_workflows.goal: Synthesize multiple expert sources (podcasts, transcripts) into unified view preserving nuance
ai_workflows.approach: Feed 3+ podcast transcripts into single context. Prompt: 'Go through all and give me overlapping conversation + most important points.' Then apply custom mosaic prompt that treats each source as orchestra section, AI as conductor connecting nuances across sources.
ai_workflows.why: Human brain serial-processes; forgets first source by third. Mosaic preserves cross-connections and minor points that become significant in aggregate.

ai_workflows.name: Fable Probability Assessment for Capex Decisions
ai_workflows.goal: Quantify probability that hyperscaler capex pays off
ai_workflows.tools: Fable (described as 'smartest LLM on the street')
ai_workflows.approach: Feed earnings details (backlog, capex, FCF, cloud growth). Ask: 'Go through details, give probability this works out over 3-5yr horizon.' Returns thesis + downside risks + probability (e.g., 70-75% for Google).
ai_workflows.why: Forces explicit probabilistic thinking; surfaces risks (obsolescence, off-balance sheet, concentration) systematically.

ai_workflows.name: QE for the Mind Framework for Stock Selection
ai_workflows.goal: Find S&P 500 companies where AI expense reduction drives disproportionate EPS growth
ai_workflows.approach: Prompt: 'Give me 5 S&P 500 cos fitting QE for Mind frame: high revenue, low margins, many employees, internal friction.' Returns: UPS, Cisco, Jabil, Centene, Walmart. Agents deployed as infrastructure not software.
ai_workflows.why: Low-margin cos get 25%+ profit boost from <1% revenue cost reduction via AI agents.

ai_workflows.name: Research Skill Architecture (Parts 3-4)
ai_workflows.goal: Systematic deep research methodology for finding non-consensus names
ai_workflows.tools: Custom prompts, mixture of experts approach
ai_workflows.approach: Multi-stage: broad scan -> filter for step-up function catalysts -> technical setup verification -> position sizing. Used for Vera Rubin report (25 names, 800 VDC).
ai_workflows.why: Structured process reduces bias; finds names before consensus.

ai_workflows.name: Fantasy Football Draft Prep as Mosaic Analogy
ai_workflows.approach: Ocean of expert talk -> visible consensus to beat -> scoreboard settles truth. Same structure as investment research.

risks: Chip obsolescence: GPU useful life 4-6 years, not 6+ as market assumes. Capex may not earn back before replacement.
Off-balance sheet commitments: ~$1T+ across hyperscalers. Not captured in standard FCF/ROIC models.
Backlog concentration risk: Google's $514B backlog heavily weighted to OpenAI. If OpenAI fails, conversion risk.
Hyperscaler bond spreads widening: Credit market signaling concern. CDS on Oracle blowing out ($7B notional but symbolically important).
China housing collapse: Prices falling monthly. State must prop stock market as alternative asset class. If fails, social instability.
Overcapacity risk: If OpenAI revenue stalls and capital markets close, compute glut possible. 'Scary time' per speaker.
2030 inflection: Speaker explicitly bearish on all public AI cos by 2030 unless AGI delayed or govt intervention.
Oil/CPI shock: Oil $68 -> $78. First non-zero CPI print mid-Sept. But 1yr inflation swaps unmoved - smart money skeptical.
Dogecoin below 20-day MA for 67 days (longest ever) = retail absent. No retail = no speculative top but also no momentum.
Clarity Act stuck below 50 votes in Senate despite Bessent 'one yard line' claim. Legislative risk.
Speaker's own technical signals: 30% names below 20-day MA = 'mini bear market'. Could break 200-day.
Anthropic growth deceleration: Not 'done' but growth rate permanently lower than priced.

actionable_takeaways.item: Buy AI pullbacks systematically - secular bull with normal 10%+ 3-month drawdowns. Speaker bought MRVL last week, adds on dips.
Focus on optical/photonics supply chain (MRVL, AOI, Vera Rubin report 25 names) for H2 2025 earnings step-up.
Monitor Google cloud backlog conversion ($260B/12mo) as proof of AI demand durability - more important than quarterly FCF.
Use Mosaic Method prompt to synthesize multiple expert sources - preserves nuance lost in serial consumption.
Apply QE for the Mind framework: screen for high-revenue, low-margin, labor-intensive S&P 500 names for AI agent deployment.
Watch estimate revisions factor (forward EPS $305) and profit margins (GDP measure) as primary macro signals - not Fed/oil headlines.
Track Dogecoin 20-day MA reclaim as retail sentiment signal; monitor Clarity Act progress for crypto infrastructure legitimacy.
China AI race is real and state-funded - DeepSeek gov't voting rights, Moonshot $50B raise. Not just US story.
Prepare for 2030 AI public market inflection - infrastructure valuations assume perpetual growth that may not materialize.
